spec.description: JVM, Tomcat and JDBC runtime diagnostics for Domibus performance testing. Container CPU/memory panels already work from cAdvisor; JVM/Tomcat/JDBC panels use the normalized domibus_jvm_*, domibus_tomcat_* and domibus_jdbc_* metric contract that will be exposed when JMX instrumentation is added.

spec.title: JMX Target Up
spec.description: Health of the future JMX exporter target(s). This panel is empty until the jmx Prometheus job exists.

spec.title: Heap Used
spec.description: Current JVM heap usage as a percentage of the configured heap maximum.

spec.title: JVM Threads
spec.description: Current live JVM thread count.

spec.title: Tomcat Busy Threads
spec.description: Busy Tomcat worker threads summed across connector/thread pools.

spec.title: JDBC Active
spec.description: Active database connections summed across exposed JDBC pools.

spec.title: Domibus Container CPU
spec.description: Current Domibus container CPU cores consumed. This works from cAdvisor even before JMX is added.

spec.title: Domibus Container CPU
spec.description: Container-level CPU for Domibus. Current baseline has no Docker CPU quota.

spec.title: Domibus Container Memory
spec.description: Container working-set memory for Domibus. Current baseline has no Docker memory cap.

spec.title: JVM Heap
spec.description: Normalized JMX metric contract for heap used, committed and maximum bytes.

spec.title: JVM Non-Heap
spec.description: Normalized JMX metric contract for non-heap memory.

spec.title: JVM Buffer Pools
spec.description: Direct/mapped buffer-pool memory where exposed by the JVM.

spec.title: GC Time Rate
spec.description: Seconds spent in garbage collection per second, split by GC collector.

spec.title: GC Collections
spec.description: Garbage-collection event rate by collector.

spec.title: JVM Threads
spec.description: Current, daemon and peak JVM thread counts.

spec.title: JVM Loaded Classes
spec.description: Currently loaded classes.

spec.title: JVM / System CPU Load
spec.description: CPU load from the JVM OperatingSystem MXBean contract.

spec.title: JVM Open File Descriptors
spec.description: Open file descriptor count where the Unix OperatingSystem MXBean is available.

spec.title: Tomcat Thread Pools
spec.description: Tomcat current, busy and maximum worker threads by pool.

spec.title: Tomcat Connections
spec.description: Tomcat connector connection counts where available.

spec.title: JDBC Connection Pools
spec.description: Active, idle and maximum JDBC connections by pool.

spec.title: 03 — Domibus · JVM & Runtime
